messages:
alec_infra: Heads-up: rolling maintenance in az3 tonight 02:30-04:30 UTC. BIOS + gpu-driver updates. We'll cordon 4 nodes at a time and drain via scheduler. Expect ~6-9% drop in hosted GPU capacity across gpu-standard and gpu-highmem. Please reschedule long jobs.

sam_ops: Are Dedicated pools affected?

alec_infra: No, Dedicated and Dedicated-GPU are on a separate lane (different maintenance window). This only hits hosted pools and burstedge.

tony_oncall: Last driver rollout caused cold KV misses that spiked tail latency. Can we pre-seed KVs?

alec_infra: Yes. Plan: kv-seed run at 01:15 UTC for az3. Command: `./kvcache-seed --region az3 --pools gpu-standard,gpu-highmem,burstedge --parallel 6 --verify` Monitor: cache hit ratio and token latency.

devex_jen: clientX nightly batch has a 03:00 job in az3. I'll move it. @product_miguel can you confirm new time?

product_miguel: Moving clientX batch to 05:00 UTC and updating runbook links.

scheduler-bot: migrate-job-clientX triggered by product_miguel at 2026-03-23T00:50:00Z

sam_ops: Cost note: if we shift traffic to other regions we'll incur cross-region egress. Ballpark +$900-1.5k depending on peak. Recommend capping cross-region bursts to critical flows.

alec_infra: Agreed. We'll throttle cross-region reroute and enable fallback to quantized model variant when egress reaches threshold.

tony_oncall: Add NIC firmware post-check to the playbook. Last time a NIC regression showed an increased error rate.

alec_infra: Will add post-check: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/nic-check --after --pattern az3-* || /opt/redwood/bin/alert-oncall --team infra` and include p95 latency smoke tests.

sam_ops: :thumbsup: do we need to notify sales/support for affected hosted tenants?

devex_jen: I'll post a short blurb in #general and update the incident status page with expected capacity dip and mitigation steps.

alec_infra: TL;DR: az3 rolling reboots 02:30-04:30 UTC, kv-seed 01:15 UTC, hosted capacity dip ~6-9%, Dedicated not impacted, limit cross-region burst to essential traffic. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/az3-reboot-2026-03-23
